title: Cursed End Update
description: A mod that adds a bunch of random things to the end, for better or for worse
body:
This is a mod that adds new content to the end dimension. So far there are no structures. As for biomes, I couldn't get them to spawn in the end so I made dimensions for each biome, also because I couldn't get them all to spawn together in one dimension☹️. But there is 7 new ores and several new mobs that behave quite strangely. But be careful when entering the end, as it is far more dangerous. Anyone who dares to step into the end will find themselves in the middle of a battlefield of mobs fighting. They also place blocks everywhere. This mod is now in full releases so there will be more stuff including in the future biomes in the end

watch my video to learn more
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Sh07lDVEw-I" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

**Ores**

Enderite: The End's version of Iron, can be made into tools and armor, is about as strong as diamond and netherite, is a bluish-purple in color

Endorsteel(Not a misspell): The End's version of Gold, The tools can break blocks faster than gold but have low durability, is blue in color

Endorium: The End's version of Diamonds, despite being the end's diamond tier ore, it is stronger than netherite, is orange in color

Cindynite: The End's version of netherite, similar to netherite, you have to smelt the ore block into scraps, and using 4 Endorsteel ingots and 4 Cindynite scraps, you can make one ingot. unlike netherite, you can craft tools and armor instead of upgrade existing gear, but this will change in the future. currently this ore can only be obtained in creative mode since the biome it spawns it won't spawn

Endpurorlite: A pink ore that is in between iron and diamond tier in strength, I added for the sole purpose of having an armor set for the Endermancer mob to wear

TNT armor: armor that is crafted with tnt, it is worn by a new mob called the Enderaxplosivarmaster. You can craft this armor for yourself, but it doesn't have a toolset, and altho this armor doesn't explode currently, it will in the future

There is also a new block that spawns naturally in the end, Avolite, it is The End's version of stone, except it crafts its own tool type and not stone tools, Avolite tools are slightly stronger than iron but weaker than diamonds, there is no Avolite armor.

**Mobs**

End Walker, a purple humanoid like mob that wears Enderite armor and carries an Enderite sword, they do insane knockback, so even just one hit could send you flying off the islands.

Neon Walker, a light blue humanoid mob that wears diamond armor and has a diamond sword, it also does insane knockback.

Resin Slayer, another humanoid mob that wears Endorium gear, they place and break resin blocks, and follow you when you hold resin clumps. these mobs also deal a ton of damage and knockback when they attack you.

Gold Digger: idk why I named this mob what it is, but it wears gold armor and attacks with an avolite sword, it is a humanoid mob that's yellow in color, but it is different from the rest, it can fly and is smaller. it drops plenty of gold equipment as well as golden foods, making it useful for getting enchanted golden apples by going through its drops when they die

Flame Dweller, a fiery mob that you'd expect to find in the nether, but nope, you find it in the end, it is a rare mob because it's a boss, when it falls from high enough to take damage, it causes an explosion, damaging it will light you on fire, it also releases a fire trail wherever it walks, upon death, it explodes, but currently it doesn't drop anything, it is also immune to it's own explosions and fire

End Creeper: a variant of the creeper that is purple and lives in the end, it will attack literally everything including other end creepers, this is not a bug, it's a feature. when end creepers explode, they pop a totem yet still die, just make sure you don't let too many end creepers get near each other or it will not end well.

If you play my other mod rubies sapphires and rainbows, you'll find a few of these mobs under a different name, you can play with both my mods at the same time, but only do so if you're ready for total chaos in the end. or play the other mod solo for it's dimensions.
